newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open little changed.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open little changed Wednesday based on market orders at 1016 EDT, traders said.

Some traders expected the market to continue to retrace recent losses with the trade seen as a steady buyer. Resistance in the benchmark December contract was seen at 75.00 cents a lb, followed by 76.00 cents, dealers said.
Tuesday, most-active December ended 0.41 cent higher at 74.16 cents, traded 74.60 to 73.80 cents. The rest closed 0.46 higher to 0.90 lower.
An estimated 18,000 lots changed hands on the day.
NYCE said nine notices were issued today, bringing the total to 778 notices issued to date.
